featured.title: LC Shuttle System
featured.lead: Livingstone's shuttles ran on fixed schedules. Miss the window and you wait. I ride them a lot, so I built a system that shows every shuttle live.
points: Live positions over WebSockets for students and drivers
OpenStreetMap and Leaflet map, JWT auth, Node.js APIs
